description_en: Modifies the whitelist for row and column permissions of a specified dataset
description_zh: 修改指定数据集行列权限的白名单
name: AddDataLevelPermissionWhiteList

parameters.help_en:
The permission type. Valid values:

ROW_LEVEL: row-level permissions
COLUMN_LEVEL: column-level permissions
parameters.help_zh:
行级权限类型：

ROW_LEVEL：行级权限，
COLUMN_LEVEL：列级权限
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en:
The operation type. Valid values: 

ADD: add entries to the whitelist
DELETE: remove entries from the whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
操作类型： 

ADD：增加白名单
DELETE：删除白名单
parameters.name: operate_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the target for which the whitelist is modified. Valid values:

1: user 
2: user group
parameters.help_zh:
修改白名单对应的类型：

1：用户 
2：用户组
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en:
The authorization targets. You can specify multiple targets separated by commas (,). Valid values:

If TargetType is set to 1 (user), the value is the user ID.
If TargetType is set to 2 (user group), the value is the user group ID
parameters.help_zh:
授权对象，同时支持多个授权对象，多个对象以英文逗号分隔。取值范围：

TargetType=1（用户）时，为用户ID。
TargetType=2（用户组）时，为用户组ID。
parameters.name: target_ids

Result.description_en:
The execution result of the operation. Valid values:

true: The request succeeded.
false: The request failed
Result.description_zh:
接口执行结果。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request succeeded.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
